description: The step-by-step working rules for one kind of task, written for an AI agent: what to call in which order, what to ask the candidate, and the lines never to cross. Read it once at the start of the task and follow it; it replaces installing the TrueInterview skills. task: overview (rules for every task), kickoff (first session), find_jobs, check_fit, resume, apply (answering one application form, which the candidate fills in and sends), tracker, inbox (recruiter email), prep (one company’s interviews) or reach_out. Free, read-only, the same for everyone.
name: get_playbook
title: Get the steps for a task
